steps.name: Accept fixture data notice
steps.goal: Tap Agree and continue on the Your data and AI providers screen for this isolated demo fixture. Wait for Home. Do not tap the root element named omg.

steps.name: Open no-project chat
steps.goal: On Home, select Chats without a project if it is not already selected. Tap Start website once. Do not send any additional message.
steps.done: The newly created chat shows its prompt and reply.
expect: What would you like your website to do?

steps.name: Open Move to folder
steps.goal: Open Session actions at the top right and select Move to folder….
steps.done: The folder picker is visible with No project selected and existing destination folders.

steps.name: Move into an existing folder
steps.goal: Tap Move to checkout. Wait for the picker to close. Do not send a message.
steps.done: The same chat remains open with the original prompt and reply.
expect: What would you like your website to do?
forbid: source session repo is not in the repo picker

steps.name: Destination grouping
steps.goal: Tap the Back button at the top left to return to Home. Then tap checkout folder. Do not open another session.
steps.done: The moved conversation is in the checkout folder.

steps.name: Open picker from moved chat
steps.goal: Open the Help me create a website. conversation. Tap Session actions at the top right. Then tap Move to folder….
steps.done: The folder picker is open again.

steps.name: Move back to No project
steps.goal: Tap Move to No project. Wait for the picker to close. Do not send a message.
steps.done: The same conversation remains open after the picker closes.
expect: What would you like your website to do?

steps.name: No-project grouping
steps.goal: Tap the Back button at the top left to return to Home. Then select Chats without a project.
steps.done: The original conversation appears under No project again.
